PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

Re-banked to restore comparison, NOT to absorb any unit of this commit or the one before it: neither adds anything to the gate. The whole +7 is ApprovalRequestHelper 1106 -> 1113 in a5079a4ca50 ("[FIX] approval: escalate once, and post the notice as markup"), which is a correct fix -- a translated str carrying tags reached readers as visible source, 1778 such notices in production -- and its seven lines are the markupsafe import, the rewrap of the body into Markup(...) % {...}, and a three-line comment saying why the markup is the template and the values are its arguments. Measured 177767 in a detached worktree at 1c8937169d1 and 177760 in one at aab5cabbf83, the commit that banked the previous floor, with the per-class diff between the two reading 305 classes over budget on BOTH sides and exactly one changed. So the previous floor was right at its own tip and 12 commits have landed since; the delta is attributable to one commit because the diff says so, not because two readings bracket it. What this floor does NOT settle, said plainly rather than left for a green reading to imply: ApprovalRequestHelper is 1113 lines against a 400-line budget, 713 over, and what it wants is a split -- approval.request is already spread over six _inherit files and the escalation/reminder cluster is a coherent seventh -- not a bump. Reclaiming the 7 elsewhere was looked for and refused twice: the class holds no dead member (_get_sequence_manager reads dead inside addons/ and is called by agromarin/approval_hr, which a grep of addons/ alone would have missed), and hoisting the notice template to a module constant would take the literal out of self.env._() and drop the term from approval.pot.
